|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Honoring What They Fight For]] (its only version). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. A same-words slip on a Players Committee release sheet that reprints a card image is part of that card image's version, not a version of its own (Bill, 17 November 2026).
